description: Today's airports rated disrupted or severe that have a page on gaduin.com, in GADUIN's ranking: those rated on departures first by disrupted share of the departures on record, then those rated on arrival cancellations; each with the same reading as get_airport_status. total_disrupted counts every such airport; returned is how many of them, from the worst, this answer lists (at most limit). Departures are rated only from 20 decided flights, so an empty list means none is rated disrupted or severe, not that every airport runs normally.

limit.description: Max airports to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

name: list_disrupted_airports
title: Most disrupted airports today
